## About

Sachin Pantha (also known as sachinpantha) is a multi-disciplinary technologist and educator based in Nepal.

- Full-Stack Web Developer (React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS)
- Blockchain Engineer (Web3, Solidity, Decentralized Applications)
- UI/UX Designer (Figma, user-centered design)
- AI Researcher (Machine Learning, Python)
- Mathematics Educator (Calculus, Linear Algebra, Discrete Mathematics)

He has 5+ years of professional experience and has taught 1000+ students across Nepal in engineering entrance preparation. He is guided by Dharma and rooted in curiosity.
